intended_object: The exceptional (special) isogeny τ of Sp₄ in characteristic 2, the half-Frobenius whose square is the Frobenius and whose odd powers give the Suzuki groups. Here it is applied to the pinned Sp₄/ℤ scheme points over the index's algebraically closed field. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the theorems that follow it.
